name: @stillpointlab/surfaces
description: Stillpoint Lab surfaces: the formats (preview + optional editor over one good) and apps (a manifest-mounted scope of goods) that sit over Context Manager.

scripts.build: npm run gen:styles && npm run build --workspaces
scripts.typecheck: npm run gen:styles && npm run build:deps && npm run typecheck --workspaces && tsc -p tooling/harness
scripts.test: npm run gen:styles && npm run build:deps && vitest run
scripts.watch:test: npm run gen:styles && npm run build:deps && vitest watch
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run format && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
scripts.serve: npm run build:common && npm run build --workspace @stillpointlab/local-host && node packages/hosts/local/dist/server/bin.js
